source_name: Monet+ — Případové studie / Reference
why_relevant: Monet+ is a Czech card/EMV and smart-card personalisation vendor selling directly to CZ banks. Its reference page names bank customers and solution areas (electronic payments, EMV, retail), which reveals unlisted private-bank programmes and their scope. A new reference appearing is a leading indicator of a bank project going live.

source_name: Monet+ — kariéra / company news (card personalisation & EMV)
why_relevant: Vendor hiring for EMV/personalisation delivery roles signals which CZ bank card programmes are ramping. Monet+ is one of the few domestic firms doing actual chip-card production and personalisation for banks.

source_name: Asseco Central Europe — Referencie / References
why_relevant: Asseco CE is a major CEE software house with CZ/SK banking clients. Its reference list and annual reports name financial-sector customers and segment revenue, exposing where private CZ bank IT spend goes. Annual reports also disclose CZ subsidiary leadership changes.

source_name: Temenos — Success Stories & Press Releases (Komerční banka)
why_relevant: Direct evidence of a CZ systemic bank's core-banking replacement that never appears in a public procurement portal. Temenos press releases name the bank, the implementation partners (Syncordis, LTIMindtree), the tech stack (private cloud, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL) and the migration timetable — i.e. the shape and duration of demand at KB.

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf — DN Series Success Stories (incl. ČSOB video case study)
why_relevant: Self-service/ATM vendor case studies name CZ bank customers (ČSOB) and their programme owners; the DN Series 300/350 launch material quotes Komerční banka's COO Jitka Haubová as pilot site. Shows where CZ cash-handling and self-service refresh cycles sit and who sponsors them.

source_name: Trask (Trask Solutions) — Financial Services / case studies
why_relevant: Trask is arguably the deepest-embedded CZ bank integrator (ČSOB, Česká spořitelna, Komerční banka). Its case studies describe concrete bank programmes (online lending time-to-money, mainframe/Windows integration, 25-year ČS integration relationship) and its magazine 'innovator' profiles regulatory-driven demand (PSD2). Strongest pointer to unlisted private-bank projects in the cell.

source_name: Aricoma / Cleverlance Enterprise Solutions — corporate site & LinkedIn
why_relevant: Aricoma group (Karel Komárek's IT holding) via Cleverlance ES supplies Česká spořitelna, ČSOB and Raiffeisenbank. Group revenue disclosures and LinkedIn posts reveal bank-account growth, delivery-unit openings and FS practice hires — none of which appear in any procurement register.

source_name: Deloitte Česká republika — vedení / partner appointments
why_relevant: Partner-level hires into Deloitte CZ's FS/corporate-finance practice mark where bank advisory demand is heading. Confirmed examples: Jan Brabec joining as Corporate Finance partner with 25+ years in investment banking; managing-partner change for the CZ/SK cluster (Miroslav Mayer, Marek Romancov).

source_name: epravo.cz — personální změny v poradenských a právních firmách
why_relevant: Czech legal/business news portal that reliably republishes Big Four and law-firm personnel press releases ('X posiluje ve finančním poradenství'). Cheap, structured aggregation point for consultancy FS-practice leadership moves that would otherwise require watching each firm's newsroom.

source_name: CFOtrends.cz — vedení poradenských firem a finančních oddělení
why_relevant: Niche CZ finance-executive trade outlet that carries advisory-firm departmental leadership changes in detail. Useful second confirmation channel and often earlier/more granular than the firms' own English pages.

source_name: KPMG Česká republika — tiskové zprávy / jmenování partnerů
why_relevant: KPMG CZ publishes an annual partner-promotion release naming practice areas, and separate releases for senior commercial hires explicitly tied to banking clients (e.g. Barbora Sirotková joining the commercial team for banking clients). Practice-area composition is a direct read on where CZ bank advisory demand is concentrating.

source_name: EY Česká republika — newsroom (jmenování vedoucích partnerů)
why_relevant: EY CZ newsroom announces consulting/FS leadership appointments with explicit sector focus (Michal Kopanič, consulting lead with financial-services focus, CE-wide). Signals which sectors EY is staffing against in CZ/CE.

source_name: ČeskéNoviny.cz (ČTK) — corporate press-release wire
why_relevant: ČTK's public news site carries vendor and consultancy press releases verbatim in easily fetchable HTML, including FS leadership appointments. Acts as a fetch-friendly mirror when corporate sites are JS-heavy or bot-defended.

source_name: ArnaThora — Finastra implementation partner in the Czech Republic
why_relevant: A small, CZ-based Finastra partner specialising in support and implementation of Fusion Midas, Fusion Essence and T24/Transact core-banking. Its existence and staffing level is direct evidence of a CZ delivery market for those core platforms; its services page and hiring reveal which core stacks are live in Czech banks.

source_name: Finastra — Find A Partner directory
why_relevant: Vendor partner directory is a classic pointer source: it enumerates the implementation firms operating in/serving the CZ market, several of which are otherwise invisible. Snowball each listed partner into its own customer references and hiring.

source_name: Software602 — pro média / SecuSign & Bank iD ecosystem
why_relevant: Software602 supplies e-signature/identity components (SecuSign, Bank iD-based signing) into the CZ banking-identity ecosystem and publishes ETSI conformance and product news. Bank iD integrations reveal which banks are extending digital-identity capability — a private-sector programme with no public tender trace.

source_name: Printec Group — solutions & customer stories (ATM ecosystem)
why_relevant: Printec-type multivendor integrator publishing its NCR Atleos partnership, managed-service scope and bank customer stories. Establishes the competitive supplier set for CZ self-service and cash-handling managed services; new CZ customer stories or a CZ delivery-unit announcement would signal demand shift.

source_name: Loomis Czech Republic — správa hotovosti / company pages
why_relevant: Cash-in-transit and cash-processing outsourcer to CZ banks; its Czech service pages describe the regulated processing chain (Act 136/2011 Sb., ČNB handover) and its parent's reporting discloses CZ volumes and site changes. A cash-handling supplier expanding or losing a bank contract is a strong indirect signal of branch/cash-network restructuring at private banks.

source_name: G4S Česko — naše služby (převoz a zpracování hotovosti, servis bankomatů)
why_relevant: The second major CZ cash-handling/ATM-servicing outsourcer. Its Czech service catalogue explicitly lists ATM servicing ('servis bankomatů') alongside cash transport — mapping the outsourced portion of private banks' physical channel. Corporate-registry entries for G4S Cash Solutions (CZ), a.s. give financials as a demand proxy.

source_name: Lupa.cz — rubrika Banky (CZ IT/bank vendor trade press)
why_relevant: Leading CZ internet/IT outlet with a dedicated banking tag; it reports supplier revenue, IT-holding restructuring and bank technology projects (e.g. Cleverlance ES revenue passing CZK 1bn inside Aricoma). Good snowball hub for discovering new vendor actors in the cell.

source_name: ChannelWorld.cz — IT channel & partner-programme news (CZ)
why_relevant: Explicitly a channel/partner-ecosystem outlet: it covers partner programmes, distributor and integrator moves and vendor country appointments in CZ. That is exactly the indirect procurement route this cell tracks — vendor-side organisational change ahead of bank spend.

source_name: CIO Business World / cio.cz — Případová studie (annual CZ IT case-study competition)
why_relevant: CIO CZ runs an annual 'Případová studie' feature/competition in which integrators submit named customer projects, including bank deployments. It aggregates vendor-authored case studies across many suppliers in one place — an efficient discovery surface for otherwise scattered bank programme disclosures.

source_name: SpeedCard s.r.o. — authorised Entrust Datacard distributor for CZ (card personalisation lines)
why_relevant: Distributor of card printers, embossers and personalisation lines in CZ since 2007. Equipment distributors are an early-warning layer: personalisation-line sales precede issuer capacity changes at banks. Also useful for mapping the smaller CZ card-production actors (BlackCard, Card Centrum, M CARD) that serve bank-adjacent issuing.

source_name: Komerční banka — 'We share ATMs' / sdílení bankomatů programme page
why_relevant: Bank-published page on the CZ interbank ATM-sharing initiative. Although a direct bank source, it is the demand-side anchor for the cash-handling/self-service vendor cell: shared-network consolidation reshapes what banks buy from ATM and CIT suppliers and how many field-service jobs exist.

source_name: CzechCrunch (cc.cz) — bank IT procurement & vendor-market reporting
why_relevant: Reported specifics on how Česká spořitelna buys IT services — supplier pool size, contract volumes and selection-cycle length — which is precisely the private-bank procurement behaviour that no public portal shows. Also a discovery channel for new CZ vendor/fintech actors.

source_name: Zlatá koruna – Finanční akademie / FinTech akademie member roster
why_relevant: The jury of the oldest CZ financial-product award publishes a full named roster of ~400 Finanční akademie + FinTech akademie members with employer affiliation, refreshed every competition year. This is effectively an annual census of who sits where across CZ banks, insurers, brokers, fintechs and finance media. Year-over-year diffing of name+employer pairs detects moves between institutions and departures without any press release.

source_name: Zlatá koruna – competition year archive (2009–2026)
why_relevant: Consistent /soutez/{YEAR} URL pattern going back to roughly 2009 gives a free ~17-year time series of jury composition, award ceremonies and participating institutions — the archival backbone that makes title-drift detection possible for this cell.

source_name: Mastercard Banka roku – Odborná porota (expert jury)
why_relevant: Named jury of analysts, economists, journalists, academics and executives with per-person bios stating current role and employer (e.g. Jana Lvová as CEO Mastercard CZ/SK since 2023). Separate 'Zvláštní odborná porota' page adds a second cohort. Prior-year jury pages remain live under distinct slugs, giving edition-to-edition title comparison.

source_name: Konference Česko: Bankovní republika (Banka roku conference)
why_relevant: The award's companion conference puts CEOs on a public panel list with exact titles — the 2025 edition named Tomáš Salomon (CEO Česká spořitelna), Tomáš Spurný (CEO MONETA), Michal Strcula (CEO Air Bank), Jana Lvová (GM Mastercard CZ/SK), Eva Zamrazilová (ČNB vice-governor). A very high-signal, low-volume CEO-level roster refreshed yearly.

source_name: Payments Summit (Czech Banking Association / ČBA) – speakers & programme
why_relevant: Organised by the Czech Banking Association (Česká bankovní asociace), the flagship CZ/SK payments conference. Speaker page lists named representatives of banks, payment institutions, ministries, the European Banking Federation and the European Payments Council with job titles — precisely the payments-org layer that is otherwise opaque. Bilingual site (cs + en) so titles appear in both languages.
